name: zed-windows
title: Zed Windows
description: Search the Zed windows you have open and jump to one, so you find what is already open instead of opening it again.
author: adamkpn

commands.name: search-windows
commands.title: Search Zed Windows
commands.subtitle: Zed
commands.description: List the open Zed windows (most recently used first), search them by folder name or path, and bring one to the front.

preferences.name: zedCliPath
preferences.title: Path to Zed CLI
preferences.description: Absolute path to the `zed` CLI. Leave empty to search /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin, PATH and /Applications/Zed.app.

preferences.name: zedDbPath
preferences.title: Zed Database
preferences.description: Zed's workspace database. Leave empty for ~/Library/Application Support/Zed/db/0-stable/db.sqlite (use 0-preview for Zed Preview).
